summary: CohortCorrSchedules manages the scheduling and generation of correspondence (such as letters or notifications) for academic cohorts within the HSPnet system. It enables users to view, add, edit, and delete correspondence schedules tied to specific timetables, departments, and programs. It provides workflows for managing schedules, reminders, and notifications, and supports various user roles and validations.
purpose: To enable administrative staff (primarily Placement Coordinators) to create, manage, and review correspondence schedules for academic cohorts, ensuring timely and appropriate communication.

workflows.name: View Correspondence Schedule
steps: Page loads with timetable, department, and program ID from query string.
Header is set showing schedule, course, term, start and end dates.
Schedules grid is populated via data binding.

workflows.name: Add/Edit Correspondence Schedule
steps: FormView switches to insert/edit mode, populates dropdowns for correspondence template, period, and reminder staff.
User enters required values: correspondence, days, rule/period, reminder staff.
Validation checks (days must be integer and required).
Schedule is added/updated based on current mode.

workflows.name: Print/View/Close Schedule
steps: User can print, refresh, or close the schedule window via buttons.

workflows.name: Reminders and Notifications
steps: Email reminders can be configured for staff.
Reminder staff selected from department/program staff filtered by Placement Coordinator role.

business_rules: Screen is only editable if user is neither ViewOnly nor CourseLeaderOnly.
Schedules cannot be edited or added unless screen is editable.
Correspondence schedule inherits from another timetable if Inherit=1 in query string.
Due date formatting and generated date tracking for notifications.
Dropdowns are dynamically filtered for valid correspondences, periods, and staff.
validations: Dropdown values must be selected for correspondence, period, and reminder staff.
User session checked for null before selecting data source.
calculations: DueDateFormatted is calculated and displayed in schedule grid.
GeneratedDate shows when letters were last generated.
conditions: If timetable, department, or program IDs are missing, certain fields may not populate.
If user is ViewOnly or CourseLeaderOnly, editing is disabled.
If no rows exist and screen is editable, show 'add' button.
system_behavior: Schedules are displayed in a grid with options to add, edit, delete, print, refresh, or close.
On add/edit, system dynamically loads dropdowns based on user and context.
After add/edit/delete, grid rebinds and UI refreshes.
Error and warning panels are available for feedback.
Modal popups are used for details editing.
exceptions: If user session is null, data source selection is canceled.
JavaScript errors prevented use of EmptyDataTemplate, so custom logic is used for 'no data found'.
content_gaps: Business logic for backend methods (e.g., CorrespondenceCohortSchedules.Add, Update, Delete, GetByID) is referenced but not fully detailed.
Details about scheduling frequency and notification triggers are not explicit.
Permissions and role management referenced but not fully explained.
Error handling detail for UI interactions and backend integration is limited.
